drawdown_definition: Maximum peak-to-trough decline of constant-notional futures P&L from the observed prefix endpoint, expressed as a fraction of capital before leverage.

success_rule.primary: The MP bank supports greater average leverage than the reference with a positive paired 95% interval, while the upper paired interval for its violation-rate increase is at most 0.02 and its mean violation excess does not increase.
success_rule.secondary: Alternatively, the MP bank lowers violations with a negative paired 95% interval while sacrificing no more than 0.10 average leverage.
